decks.summary: The designated hitter beside a dedicated clue finder: Machete, Kukri and Beat Cop kill everything, Leo De Luca adds actions, and her ability pays her for every enemy she engages.
Dunwich-era Zoey who engages everything for money and one-shots big enemies with Machete, the .45 and Double or Nothing, carrying Ward of Protection for treacheries.

Beginner Zoey from Core, Dunwich and Edge of the Earth: .45 Automatics, Machete, Beat Cop and Guard Dog clear enemies, Prepared for the Worst finds the guns, Emergency Aid and Bandages keep her standing.

Deck-thinning Zoey: Underworld Support, Stick to the Plan and Short Supply shrink her deck to ten cards so Prepared for the Worst always finds Cyclopean Hammer, with a light bless package for Nephthys.
Blades-and-zealotry Zoey for Hard: Timeworn Brand and Machete for burst damage, Brother Xavier to soak and Blood Eclipse to cash him in, On the Hunt to pull enemies to her.
One Core Set plus Dunwich Zoey as the killing machine beside a Seeker or Pete, with plenty of horror healing and a Shrivelling for the fights melee cannot handle.
A 21-card Zoey that uses Underworld Support and Stick to the Plan to find Cyclopean Hammer on turn one, then hunts enemies down with On the Hunt and "Get over here!".
Solo Zoey kept cheap and fast: Machete and the .45 for enemies, Flashlight, Drawn to the Flame and Evidence! for clues, and many skills; tested on Hard in Dunwich.
Relic Zoey who fights like Daniela: Hunter's Armor, Guard Dog and Zoey's Cross punish every attack without tests, Runic Axe finishes the job, and Dr. Elli Horowitz fetches the relics; no clues.
A deckbuilding tutorial: one Core plus Dunwich Zoey built as the fighter half of a classic pair with Daisy Walker, with a spread of weapons and Taunt to protect her.
